Galerians - Requiem Manentia

Ah, Galerians, one of those iP that REALLY need a massively expanded remake and a rediscovery, so much potential untapped...

A sequel to Galerians (1999) and Galerians Ash (2003) featuring as narrator and main character Pat, the genius wiz-kid hacker from Galerians Ash, in his own quest ot dispense justice upon Nitro, Spider and Parano, the Last Galerians... how has Pat's own genius mind planned to hurt the Last Galerians?

At the end of the comic, 7 bonus non-canon to the story artworks featuring Lilia interacting with all the Galerians (also with Dorothy the evil AI computer).

You can read mine and other peoples AI Gen comics here:
https://storinex.com/creator/ddark92
